name: aether-sentinels
description: Aether Sentinels — a strategic HTML5 tower defense game with unique towers, multiple maps, boss levels, and animations. Packaged for Google Play via Capacitor.
//: The browser game has NO runtime dependencies - `npm run serve` and `npm test` work with a bare checkout. Capacitor is only needed to build the Android wrapper; those packages are optional so a plain clone never has to install anything.
